It represents a co-occurring same-episode exam and must not be used as a prior-or-follow-up link.
join_hazards: Do not inner-join away dangling references or infer the explicit accession solely from linked_study_flag.

caveats: Internal V1c covers every EMBEDv1 exam and patient but is incomplete relative to internal clinical V2, which contains later coverage.
A clinical V2 exam can therefore have no matching V1c image row.
An unmatched clinical exam is not evidence that the exam had no images.
An inner join on the accession discards clinical V2 exams outside V1c coverage.
Physical linkage does not establish image availability for all internal V2 exams.
Physical cardinality is many-to-many because the clinical table repeats exam rows and the metadata table holds many image rows per exam; each image still belongs to one exam clinically.
The clinical endpoint is taken from the MagView inventory; the shared accession namespace and cross-table exam identity are maintainer confirmed.
join_hazards: Both endpoints repeat the accession, so an accession join multiplies clinical association rows against image rows; declare a grouping and de-duplication policy before joining.

Use the anonymized patient identifier for cross-table patient identity and as a consistency check rather than as an exam-identity component; a cross-patient accession association is invalid and must not be retained as a valid linkage.
Image laterality may be used only as a consistency check; it is not the imaging-finding or procedure side and must not be made a join-identity component.
Do not derive an image-availability flag, a no-image cohort, or an exclusion rule from join outcomes.

caveats: The shared identifier supports cross-table patient identity and patient-agreement checking on an accession join; it is not an independent image-attachment route.
The clinical and image-metadata occurrences use the same anonymization namespace.
V1c patient coverage is narrower than internal clinical V2, so an unmatched patient is outside extraction coverage.
join_hazards: Joining on the patient identifier alone crosses every exam and image of that patient; always combine it with the accession.

caveats: The relationship is realized by row co-location rather than by a key join: an image row's region-of-interest collections are carried in that same row.
One image row carries zero or more regions and each region belongs to exactly one image row, preserving the semantic rule that a region has exactly one source image.
The endpoint locator is intended for every extracted image row, and its basename supplies dataset-version-scoped SOP Instance UID identity; a missing value likely reflects anonymization failure.
Observed missing locator values make the physical endpoint incomplete, while row co-location still expresses the image-to-region attachment; no region identity is represented.
There is no separate region-of-interest table and none should be inferred.
join_hazards: Exploding the serialized collections multiplies image rows; the resulting region rows have positional order only and no identifier.
Do not join regions across image rows of one acquisition group; cross-image correspondence is not represented.

region_of_interest.label: Image region of interest
region_of_interest.definition: One represented spatial region originating on exactly one breast-imaging source image.
region_of_interest.grain: one represented region of interest on exactly one source image
caveats: The internal V1c physical representation is a serialized per-image collection using [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] coordinates in attached DICOM pixel-array space.
ROIs originate from radiologists during routine clinical operations; some DBT frame depths are inferred by an in-house model and marked by ROI_depth_derived.
No region identifier is represented: a region is addressable only by its position within one image row's aligned collections.
Correspondence among ROIs across simultaneous FFDM, DBT, and synthetic 2D images is not represented.
A represented ROI is not automatically equivalent to a clinical finding; same-side attribution is reliable only in the single-finding case.

pathology_specimen.label: Pathology specimen
pathology_specimen.definition: A putative procedure-associated tissue-specimen representation whose presence, completeness, reliability, identity, and cardinality remain unresolved in internal MagView.
pathology_specimen.grain: one putative pathology specimen association within an internal MagView finding/procedure context
caveats: Current internal V2 operations should not rely on specimen-level fields.
No globally unique or durable specimen identity is established.
A putative specimen representation may repeat across physical rows and is not equivalent to one pathology descriptor slot.

internal-v2.technical.cancer_registry_re.label: Cancer-registry record identifier
internal-v2.technical.cancer_registry_re.definition: Technical identifier for a record in a separate Georgia cancer-registry-derived pathology table, scoped jointly with the internal patient identifier.
caveats: The value is meaningful only together with empi_anon.
It is not itself a cancer diagnosis, cancer outcome, or proof that diagnosis occurred at Emory.
The referenced registry table is not yet physically bound.

internal-v2.exam.accession_source_type.label: Accession source-system type
internal-v2.exam.accession_source_type.definition: Source-system category recorded for a current or linked imaging accession.
caveats: Current and linked occurrences use one concept with an explicit accession-role qualifier.
This category does not establish linkage completeness or exam chronology.

internal-v2.procedure.biopsy_site.label: Biopsy site slot
internal-v2.procedure.biopsy_site.definition: Source-system biopsy site designation recorded as a lettered site slot.
caveats: The lettered slot is not an anatomic breast-location code.

internal-v2.procedure.diagnostic_disposi.label: Diagnostic disposition
internal-v2.procedure.diagnostic_disposi.definition: Recorded internal-versus-external diagnostic handling for a procedure-associated pathology record.
caveats: The field does not identify a facility or prove transfer completeness.

internal-v2.pathology.concordance_status.label: Recorded pathology concordance status
internal-v2.pathology.concordance_status.definition: Source-system concordance status associated with a pathology specimen.
caveats: The comparison entities are not named by the available dictionaries; do not assume a specific radiology-pathology concordance definition.

internal-v2.pathology.histologic_grade.label: Histologic grade
internal-v2.pathology.histologic_grade.definition: Recorded combined histologic-grade category for a pathology diagnosis.

internal-v2.pathology.tnm_primary_tumor.label: Pathologic TNM primary-tumor category
internal-v2.pathology.tnm_primary_tumor.definition: Recorded pathologic primary-tumor component of TNM classification.
caveats: The profile preserves source tokens and dictionary wording without correcting apparent source-system spellings.

internal-v2.pathology.tnm_regional_nodes.label: Pathologic TNM regional-node category
internal-v2.pathology.tnm_regional_nodes.definition: Recorded pathologic regional-lymph-node component of TNM classification.
caveats: Both comparison legends attach an incompatible primary-tumor dictionary to this field; represented pN token meanings remain unresolved.

internal-v2.pathology.tnm_distant_metast.label: TNM distant-metastasis category
internal-v2.pathology.tnm_distant_metast.definition: Recorded distant-metastasis component of TNM classification.
caveats: The literal CMO source token is preserved; it is not silently corrected to a presumed alternative spelling.

internal-v2.pathology.tnm_descriptors.label: TNM descriptors
internal-v2.pathology.tnm_descriptors.definition: Source string containing one or more recorded TNM descriptor codes.
caveats: Parse comma-delimited tokens; ordering and repetition do not change meaning.

internal-v2.pathology.tnm_residual_tumor.label: TNM residual-tumor category
internal-v2.pathology.tnm_residual_tumor.definition: Recorded residual-tumor category in TNM staging context.
caveats: Internal source tokens use uppercase forms of the lowercase comparison-dictionary codes.

internal-v2.pathology.tnm_stage_comment.label: TNM staging comment
internal-v2.pathology.tnm_stage_comment.definition: Free-text TNM staging comment associated with a pathology diagnosis.
caveats: This is not a normalized stage category and its content is not exposed by the catalog.

internal-v2.pathology.focality.label: Pathology focality
internal-v2.pathology.focality.definition: Recorded focality category for a pathology specimen.

internal-v2.pathology.focus_count.label: Number of pathology foci
internal-v2.pathology.focus_count.definition: Recorded number of foci for a pathology specimen.
caveats: Range and null semantics are not documented.

internal-v2.pathology.specimen_size.label: Pathology specimen size
internal-v2.pathology.specimen_size.definition: Recorded size of a pathology specimen.
caveats: The available dictionaries do not document units; similarly named secondary physical columns remain unmapped.

internal-v2.pathology.dcis_size.label: DCIS size
internal-v2.pathology.dcis_size.definition: Recorded size of ductal carcinoma in situ in a pathology specimen.
caveats: The available dictionaries do not document units.

internal-v2.pathology.invasive_size.label: Invasive carcinoma size
internal-v2.pathology.invasive_size.definition: Recorded size of invasive carcinoma in a pathology specimen.
caveats: The available dictionaries do not document units; exceptional negative source values have unresolved meanings.

internal-v2.pathology.specimen_margin_di.label: Directional specimen-margin distance
internal-v2.pathology.specimen_margin_di.definition: Recorded distance to a named directional specimen margin, in millimeters.
search_terms: superior inferior anterior posterior medial lateral margin
caveats: Direction is carried by a scalar mapping qualifier; exceptional negative source values are not validated measurements.

internal-v2.pathology.specimen_integrity.label: Specimen integrity
internal-v2.pathology.specimen_integrity.definition: Recorded integrity category for a pathology specimen.
caveats: The represented N code is absent from the comparison dictionaries and remains unresolved.

internal-v2.pathology.specimen_number.label: Specimen number
internal-v2.pathology.specimen_number.definition: Source-system specimen number scoped to a procedure-associated pathology representation.
caveats: The value is not globally unique, is not a durable cross-release identifier, and may repeat across physical rows.

internal-v2.pathology.specimen_embedded_.label: Specimen embedded status
caveats: The dictionary labels a yes/no field but supplies no code meanings; represented code semantics remain unresolved.

internal-v2.pathology.estrogen_receptor_.label: Estrogen-receptor result
internal-v2.pathology.estrogen_receptor_.definition: Coded estrogen-receptor immunoreactivity result or workflow state for a pathology specimen.
caveats: The vocabulary mixes result polarity, low expression, and workflow or residual-disease states.

internal-v2.pathology.estrogen_receptor_.label: Estrogen-receptor percentage
internal-v2.pathology.estrogen_receptor_.definition: Recorded estrogen-receptor percentage for a pathology specimen.
caveats: Range, measurement method, and exceptional-value semantics are not established by the dictionaries.

internal-v2.pathology.her2_ihc_result.label: HER2 immunohistochemistry result
internal-v2.pathology.her2_ihc_result.definition: Coded HER2 immunohistochemistry score or workflow state for a pathology specimen.
caveats: The vocabulary mixes assay results with workflow and residual-disease states.

internal-v2.pathology.her2_ish_result.label: HER2 in-situ hybridization result
internal-v2.pathology.her2_ish_result.definition: Coded FISH/CISH HER2 result or workflow state for a pathology specimen.
caveats: The vocabulary mixes polarity, copy-number or ratio categories, workflow states, and residual-disease states.

internal-v2.pathology.ki67_result.label: Ki-67 coded result
internal-v2.pathology.ki67_result.definition: Coded Ki-67 result category for a pathology specimen.
caveats: This source field is a mixed coded category, not one scalar percentage.

internal-v2.pathology.extracapsular_exte.label: Extracapsular extension status
internal-v2.pathology.extracapsular_exte.definition: Recorded extracapsular-extension category associated with nodal pathology.
caveats: The dictionary's K code has a semantically incongruent skin-related meaning and remains source specific.

internal-v2.pathology.nodal_evaluation_m.label: Nodal evaluation method
internal-v2.pathology.nodal_evaluation_m.definition: Recorded method used to evaluate lymph-node pathology, including a not-performed state.

internal-v2.pathology.sentinel_nodes_rem.label: Sentinel nodes removed
internal-v2.pathology.sentinel_nodes_rem.definition: Recorded number of sentinel lymph nodes removed.

internal-v2.pathology.nodes_removed.label: Lymph nodes removed
internal-v2.pathology.nodes_removed.definition: Recorded total number of lymph nodes removed.

internal-v2.pathology.nodes_positive.label: Positive lymph nodes
internal-v2.pathology.nodes_positive.definition: Recorded number of positive lymph nodes.

internal-v2.pathology.extensive_intraduc.label: Extensive intraductal component status
internal-v2.pathology.extensive_intraduc.definition: Recorded extensive intraductal component category for a pathology diagnosis.

internal-v2.pathology.isolated_cell_coun.label: Isolated cell count
internal-v2.pathology.isolated_cell_coun.definition: Recorded number of isolated cells in the represented pathology characterization.
caveats: The comparison legend does not establish the isolated cell type.

internal-v2.pathology.largest_deposit_si.label: Largest pathology deposit size
internal-v2.pathology.largest_deposit_si.definition: Recorded size of the largest deposit in the represented pathology characterization, in millimeters.
caveats: The comparison legend does not establish the deposit type or anatomic scope.

internal-v2.image.dicom_file_locator.label: Anonymized DICOM file locator
internal-v2.image.dicom_file_locator.definition: Technical reference to the anonymized DICOM file for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The full path is a technical locator; its filename without the .dcm suffix is the anonymized SOP Instance UID and supplies dataset-version-scoped image identity.
It is intended to be defined for every extracted image row.
A missing value likely means anonymization failed before the de-identified DICOM could be saved and is a data-quality defect.

missing_states.meaning: The de-identified image file and its exported SOP Instance UID representation are unavailable, likely because anonymization failed before the file could be saved
caveats: Treat this as a data-quality defect, not intended optionality.

internal-v2.image.sop_instance_identifie.label: Anonymized SOP Instance UID
internal-v2.image.sop_instance_identifie.definition: Anonymized DICOM SOP Instance UID identifying one image durably within an EMBED dataset version and encoded as the anon_dicom_path filename without its .dcm suffix.
caveats: The UID is not exported as a separate metadata column and must be parsed from the file basename.
No durability or equality across dataset versions is asserted.
A missing anon_dicom_path makes this identity unavailable for that row and is a data-quality defect.

internal-v2.image.png_render_locator.label: Rendered image locator component
internal-v2.image.png_render_locator.definition: Legacy technical reference component for a PNG conversion originally generated for EMBEDv1 FFDM images.
caveats: This legacy conversion should not be used for current or future work; use the anonymized DICOM file instead.
The historical PNG conversion can affect downstream applications, including model generalizability.
A missing component is not evidence that no source DICOM image exists.

internal-v2.image.dicom_study_identifier.label: Source DICOM study identifier
internal-v2.image.dicom_study_identifier.definition: Technical study identifier carried on an internal V1c image row.
caveats: This is a short study identifier attribute, not a study instance identifier; its relationship to acc_anon is unknown and it is rarely, if ever, used internally.
During anonymization acc_anon is written to the distinct DICOM AccessionNumber element.
It does not distinguish one image row.

internal-v2.image.dicom_series_number.label: Source DICOM series number
internal-v2.image.dicom_series_number.definition: Technical series number carried on an internal V1c image row.
caveats: Series and instance numbers together do not distinguish one image row within an accession.

internal-v2.image.dicom_instance_number.label: Source DICOM instance number
internal-v2.image.dicom_instance_number.definition: Technical instance number carried on an internal V1c image row.
caveats: Series and instance numbers together do not distinguish one image row within an accession.

internal-v2.image.acquisition_group_iden.label: Derived acquisition-group identifier
internal-v2.image.acquisition_group_iden.definition: Stable, globally unique identifier for one simultaneous acquisition group, constructed as acc_anon, ProtocolName with spaces replaced by hyphens, and ContentTime cast as an integer.
caveats: The serialized form is {acc_anon}_{normalized ProtocolName}_{integer ContentTime}.
It is stable across extraction reruns and can group several image rows from one simultaneous acquisition.
It is not a region-of-interest correspondence representation.

internal-v2.image.source_modality.label: Source DICOM image modality
internal-v2.image.source_modality.definition: Modality recorded on the source DICOM instance for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: This image-level modality is separate from the exam-level modality description bound on the clinical table.
It is not the derived mammographic image-type classification.

internal-v2.image.dicom_image_type.label: Source DICOM image-type attribute
internal-v2.image.dicom_image_type.definition: Serialized multi-valued source DICOM image-type attribute for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The value is a serialized sequence of source tokens; its element count varies and empty elements occur.
Token meanings are source-system specific and are not interpreted here.
This attribute, not the derived classification, separates contrast-enhanced, stereotactic, post-biopsy, scout, and screen-save acquisitions.

internal-v2.image.derived_image_type.label: Derived mammographic image-type classification
internal-v2.image.derived_image_type.definition: Pipeline-derived classification of the mammographic acquisition form represented by one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The classification separates mammographic acquisition forms only; every non-mammographic source modality falls into the residual class.
It is not exhaustive: source image-type tokens equivalent to a named class also occur under the residual class.
ROI_SS and ROI_SSC are secondary screen-capture annotation-transfer artifacts retained solely for ROI extraction and are not intended for other use.

internal-v2.image.view_position.label: Image view position
internal-v2.image.view_position.definition: Represented mammographic projection or view for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: No view code dictionary is established for internal V1c; represented values include untrimmed, lowercase, and specimen radiography variants, so comparison needs explicit normalization.
The plain view-position attribute and the view code-sequence meaning are separate occurrences and are not reconciled.
View position is separate from image laterality.

internal-v2.image.view_modifier.label: Image view modifier
internal-v2.image.view_modifier.definition: Represented view-modifier meaning applied to one internal V1c image row's projection.
caveats: Represented as a source code meaning rather than a governed internal code list.
Only one modifier occurrence is inventoried; a source sequence may carry more.

internal-v2.image.spot_magnification_fla.label: Derived spot or magnification indicator
internal-v2.image.spot_magnification_fla.definition: Pipeline-derived indicator marking an internal V1c image row as a spot-compression or magnification acquisition.
caveats: Only the affirmative state is represented, and the affirmative state does not occur on tomosynthesis-classified rows.
A missing value is not a negative determination.
The flag does not distinguish spot compression from magnification.

internal-v2.image.source_laterality.label: Source DICOM laterality attribute
internal-v2.image.source_laterality.definition: Laterality recorded on a source DICOM laterality attribute for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: Two separate source laterality attributes are inventoried; they sit at different DICOM levels and are not reconciled here.
A bilateral source value is represented and is not resolved into the derived final image laterality.
Image laterality is not the imaging-finding or procedure side.

internal-v2.image.derived_laterality.label: Derived final image laterality
internal-v2.image.derived_laterality.definition: Reliable pipeline-resolved breast laterality assigned to one internal V1c image row and preferred for determining which breast the image represents.
caveats: Only left and right are represented; a bilateral source laterality yields no derived value.
A missing value is not bilateral.
Its exact derivation and the LateralityDeriveFlag meanings remain unknown, but ImageLateralityFinal itself is the maintained reliable image-side attribute.
Image side is not automatically finding or procedure side.

internal-v2.image.laterality_derivation_.label: Image-laterality derivation indicator
internal-v2.image.laterality_derivation_.definition: Represented indicator accompanying the derived final image laterality of one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The intended meaning of each represented value is not established; only structural association with the source and derived laterality fields was observed.
The indicator is itself sometimes absent, including on rows whose derived laterality is represented, so it is not a total provenance record.

internal-v2.image.body_part_examined.label: Source body part examined
internal-v2.image.body_part_examined.definition: Body part recorded on the source DICOM instance for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: Represented values vary in case and include a bilateral form, so comparison needs explicit normalization.
It does not carry image laterality.

internal-v2.image.presentation_intent.label: Source presentation intent
internal-v2.image.presentation_intent.definition: Whether the source DICOM instance for one internal V1c image row is intended for presentation or for further processing.
caveats: Not represented for tomosynthesis-classified or screen-save classified rows, so presentation intent cannot be assumed for them.
The pixel-handling consequence of each represented value is not established here.

internal-v2.image.photometric_interpreta.label: Source photometric interpretation
internal-v2.image.photometric_interpreta.definition: Represented source DICOM photometric interpretation governing the displayed polarity of one internal V1c image row's pixel data.
caveats: Both represented monochrome values occur, so display polarity must be resolved per image rather than assumed.
The polarity implied by each value is not asserted here and must be resolved against the DICOM standard before rendering.

internal-v2.image.pixel_representation.label: Source pixel representation
internal-v2.image.pixel_representation.definition: Represented source DICOM pixel-representation value for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The signedness implied by the represented value is not asserted here.

internal-v2.image.pixel_matrix_dimension.label: Pixel matrix dimension
internal-v2.image.pixel_matrix_dimension.definition: Size of one axis of the pixel matrix of an internal V1c image row.
caveats: The row and column axes are separate occurrences of this concept and are distinguished by an axis qualifier.
Region-of-interest rectangles are not guaranteed to lie inside these dimensions.

internal-v2.image.pixel_bit_depth.label: Pixel bit-depth attribute
internal-v2.image.pixel_bit_depth.definition: Represented source DICOM bit-depth attribute of an internal V1c image row's pixel data.
caveats: Three separate bit-depth attributes are occurrences of this concept and are distinguished by an attribute qualifier.

internal-v2.image.samples_per_pixel.label: Samples per pixel
internal-v2.image.samples_per_pixel.definition: Represented number of samples per pixel for an internal V1c image row.

internal-v2.image.images_in_acquisition.label: Images in acquisition
internal-v2.image.images_in_acquisition.definition: Represented source DICOM count of images belonging to the acquisition that produced an internal V1c image row.
caveats: This is not a multiframe frame count; no inventoried column states a frame count, so it bounds no region-of-interest frame index.
It is not represented on every row.

internal-v2.image.pixel_spacing.label: Pixel spacing attribute
internal-v2.image.pixel_spacing.definition: Serialized source DICOM pixel-spacing attribute for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The value is a serialized pair; delimiter and unit semantics are not documented in the extraction.
Two separate spacing attributes are occurrences of this concept and are not reconciled with one another.

internal-v2.image.compression_force.label: Compression force
internal-v2.image.compression_force.definition: Represented source DICOM compression force applied for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The unit is not documented in the extraction.

internal-v2.image.body_part_thickness.label: Compressed body part thickness
internal-v2.image.body_part_thickness.definition: Represented source DICOM compressed thickness of the imaged body part for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The unit is not documented in the extraction.

internal-v2.image.tube_voltage_kvp.label: X-ray tube voltage
internal-v2.image.tube_voltage_kvp.definition: Represented source DICOM peak kilovoltage for one internal V1c image row.

internal-v2.image.entrance_dose_mgy.label: Entrance dose in milligray
internal-v2.image.entrance_dose_mgy.definition: Represented source DICOM entrance dose in milligray for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: Other represented dose and exposure attributes retain their standard DICOM element meanings but remain inventoried without dedicated catalogue concepts.

internal-v2.image.device_manufacturer.label: Acquisition device manufacturer
internal-v2.image.device_manufacturer.definition: Represented manufacturer of the device that produced one internal V1c image row.
caveats: Represented values include image-processing and secondary-capture vendors as well as acquisition-system vendors.

internal-v2.image.device_model.label: Acquisition device model
internal-v2.image.device_model.definition: Represented model name of the device that produced one internal V1c image row.
caveats: Represented values include non-mammographic and workstation models.

internal-v2.image.device_software_versio.label: Acquisition device software versions
internal-v2.image.device_software_versio.definition: Serialized represented software versions of the device that produced one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The value is a serialized sequence of vendor-specific component versions and is not parsed here.

internal-v2.image.detector_type.label: Detector type
internal-v2.image.detector_type.definition: Represented source DICOM detector type for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: Represented values include film and storage acquisition forms as well as direct digital detection.

internal-v2.image.breast_implant_present.label: Breast implant present attribute
internal-v2.image.breast_implant_present.definition: Represented source DICOM indication of whether a breast implant is present for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: This is an image-level acquisition attribute and is not a clinical implant finding or history.
It is not represented on every row.

internal-v2.image.burned_in_annotation_f.label: Burned-in annotation attribute
internal-v2.image.burned_in_annotation_f.definition: Represented source DICOM declaration of whether one internal V1c image row contains sufficient burned-in annotation to identify the patient and the date the image was acquired.
caveats: The attribute is a source declaration and is not a verification of the pixel data.
NO does not mean that the image contains no annotation; it means the source does not declare sufficient burned-in annotation to identify the patient and acquisition date.
The catalogue does not prescribe an action for YES, NO, or absence.

missing_states.meaning: The source makes no Burned In Annotation declaration; sufficient identifying annotation may or may not be present
caveats: Do not interpret absence as NO.

internal-v2.image.dicom_conversion_type.label: Source conversion type
internal-v2.image.dicom_conversion_type.definition: Represented source DICOM conversion type for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: Secondary captures and screen saves were excluded except ROI_SS and ROI_SSC annotation images retained solely for ROI extraction.

internal-v2.image.extraction_category_fl.label: Extraction category flag
internal-v2.image.extraction_category_fl.definition: Pipeline-assigned extraction category recorded on one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The intended meaning of each represented value is not established, and the non-default value must not be read as evidence that no image exists for that row.
The represented values are strongly associated with the derived image-type classification rather than distributed across it.

internal-v2.image.pixel_array_present_fl.label: Legacy pixel-array determination flag
internal-v2.image.pixel_array_present_fl.definition: Obsolete pipeline field that formerly attempted to record a pixel-array determination for one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The field is no longer populated because checking it substantially slowed anonymization.
Existing values and missingness are not reliable and must not be used to infer pixel-data availability.

internal-v2.image.region_of_interest_cou.label: Region-of-interest count on an image
internal-v2.image.region_of_interest_cou.definition: Represented number of regions of interest carried by one internal V1c image row.
caveats: The count describes the row's serialized collections and is not a clinical finding count.
Zero is represented and accompanies empty collections.

internal-v2.roi.coordinate_collection.label: Region-of-interest coordinate collection
internal-v2.roi.coordinate_collection.definition: Nested serialized list of [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] rectangles with inclusive minimum and maximum bounds in the attached DICOM image's pixel-array coordinate space, one per region of interest.
caveats: Coordinates correspond directly to the attached pixel array and require no spacing, orientation, or other coordinate transformation.
An inclusive rectangle has height y_max - y_min + 1 and width x_max - x_min + 1; NumPy slices therefore use y_max + 1 and x_max + 1 as their exclusive stops.

The expected curated invariant is 0 <= y_min <= y_max < Rows and 0 <= x_min <= x_max < Columns; residual out-of-bounds coordinates may be safely clipped to the attached image's valid pixel-array bounds.
The collection is aligned by position with the frame-index and depth-derivation collections; position is not region identity.

missing_states.meaning: No region of interest is represented for the image row
caveats: An empty collection is not evidence that the image was never reviewed or contains no abnormality.

internal-v2.roi.frame_index_collection.label: Region-of-interest frame-index collection
internal-v2.roi.frame_index_collection.definition: Nested serialized collection of zero-based frame-index lists aligned one-for-one with the ROI coordinate collection; a DBT ROI can match one or several frames.
caveats: Frame indices are informative only for DBT images; represented values on 2D or synthetic 2D images are not informative.
Aligned by position with the coordinate collection; a region's frame list may hold one or several indices.
No inventoried column states a frame count, so no upper bound is established.

missing_states.representation: empty serialized collection alongside represented regions of interest
missing_states.meaning: No frame indices are represented for the row's regions
caveats: An empty frame collection means absent frame information, not frame zero.

internal-v2.roi.depth_derivation_flag_co.label: Region-of-interest depth-derivation flag collection
internal-v2.roi.depth_derivation_flag_co.definition: Serialized collection of one boolean per ROI; true means an in-house model inferred the DBT frame-depth coordinates after radiologist 2D coordinates were transferred to the DBT image.
caveats: Its length agrees with the represented region count because the ROI collections are generated in tandem.
True refers to inferred z/depth information; the x/y coordinates originate from a radiologist clinical annotation.
It does not provide stable ROI identity or an individual annotator identifier.

clinical.image-region-of-interest.label: Image has region of interest
clinical.image-region-of-interest.attribution: A represented region of interest is attached to one represented image.
attribution_limitations: The relationship does not establish unconditional equivalence between an ROI and a clinical finding; same-side attribution is reliable only when exactly one finding is represented on that accession side.
Internal V1c represents no region identifier, so a region is identified only by its position within one image row's collections.
clinical.image-region-of-interest.temporal_qualification: No independent ROI event or availability time is currently asserted.
caveats: The internal V1c physical route is row co-location on the image-metadata table, not a join to a separate region-of-interest table.
Correspondence among regions on separate images of one acquisition group is not represented.

internal-v2.clinical.procedure-pathology.label: Procedure has pathology specimen
internal-v2.clinical.procedure-pathology.attribution: Putative procedure-associated representation of a tissue specimen.
attribution_limitations: Procedure-level information is reliable, but specimen-level presence, completeness, identity, and cardinality remain unresolved.
No unique specimen identifier proves one-to-one attribution.
internal-v2.clinical.procedure-pathology.temporal_qualification: The specimen is downstream of tissue sampling or surgery; specimen-collection time is unsupported.
caveats: The relationship is unresolved and must not be used as a specimen-matching rule.

internal-v2.clinical.pathology-specimen-.label: Pathology specimen has descriptor observation
internal-v2.clinical.pathology-specimen-.attribution: A pathology descriptor slot may be co-located with a putative specimen association.
attribution_limitations: Slot order and duplicate occurrences do not create clinical weight.
Specimen presence, identity, completeness, reliability, and cardinality are unresolved.
internal-v2.clinical.pathology-specimen-.temporal_qualification: Descriptor observations are documented in the downstream pathology context.
caveats: Row co-location does not prove a specimen-to-observation attribution; current operations should not rely on this edge.

internal-v2.clinical.pathology-specimen-.label: Pathology specimen supports diagnosis state
internal-v2.clinical.pathology-specimen-.attribution: Descriptor observations and characterization co-located with a putative specimen representation support a represented pathology diagnosis state.
attribution_limitations: Specimen presence and attribution are unresolved and must not be required for diagnosis-level use.
A finding can carry several procedure or putative specimen rows with different severity states.
Invalid severity code 6 and unexplained descriptor codes require explicit handling.
internal-v2.clinical.pathology-specimen-.temporal_qualification: Diagnosis documentation is downstream of the imaging finding and procedure.
caveats: No finding-level reduction across all linked rows is supplied.
Current internal operations should not rely on the specimen endpoint of this relationship.

internal-v2.guardrail.absent-image-metad.title: Missing image metadata is not missing imaging
internal-v2.guardrail.absent-image-metad.statement: Do not treat a clinical V2 exam without a matching internal V1c row, a missing legacy PNG locator, or has_pix_array as evidence that no DICOM image exists.
internal-v2.guardrail.absent-image-metad.rationale: V1c completely covers EMBEDv1 but is narrower than clinical V2; PNG conversion fields are legacy, has_pix_array is obsolete and unreliable, and a missing anon_dicom_path instead indicates a data-quality failure to save the anonymized DICOM.
caveats: Use anon_dicom_path for current DICOM availability, treating its absence as an anonymization data-quality error rather than intended optionality.

internal-v2.guardrail.roi-finding-attrib.title: ROI-to-finding attribution depends on side-level finding multiplicity
internal-v2.guardrail.roi-finding-attrib.statement: Same-accession, same-side ROI attribution is generally reliable only when exactly one clinical finding is represented on that side; when multiple findings are present, EMBED supplies no reliable individual ROI-to-finding link.
internal-v2.guardrail.roi-finding-attrib.rationale: The ROI collections contain no finding identifier. Multiple ROIs can all belong to the single represented finding, but accession and side cannot distinguish several findings from one another.
caveats: An ROI need not mark the most severe lesion or a lesion that later became cancer.

internal-v2.guardrail.roi-coordinate-bou.title: ROI coordinates use inclusive, normally in-bounds pixel bounds
internal-v2.guardrail.roi-coordinate-bou.statement: Interpret ROI rectangles as inclusive [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] pixel-array bounds. Curated coordinates are expected to lie within the attached image; if residual out-of-bounds coordinates are encountered downstream, they may be safely clipped to the valid pixel-array bounds.
internal-v2.guardrail.roi-coordinate-bou.rationale: Coordinates outside y indices 0 through Rows - 1 or x indices 0 through Columns - 1 are residual data-quality conditions rather than intended representation semantics. Inclusive bounds also require adding one to y_max and x_max when using exclusive-stop slicing APIs such as NumPy.
caveats: The supported clipping behavior is recovery for residual defects; it does not redefine out-of-bounds values as an intended source representation.

coverage.internal-v2.specimen-collection.subject: time.specimen-collection
coverage.internal-v2.specimen-collection.summary: The assessed internal V2 MagView table contains no supported specimen-collection time binding.
caveats: Do not substitute procedure date, pathology-report date, or an undocumented date-like column.

coverage.internal-v2.downstream-availabi.subject: time.downstream-availability
coverage.internal-v2.downstream-availabi.summary: The assessed internal V2 MagView table contains no supported universal timestamp for downstream information availability.
caveats: Physical co-location must not be treated as contemporaneous availability.

coverage.internal-v2.roi-physical-bindin.subject: internal-v2.roi-context
coverage.internal-v2.roi-physical-bindin.summary: Internal V1c region-of-interest information is physically cataloged as tandem-generated aligned collections: coordinates use inclusive [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] DICOM pixel-array bounds, frames are informative for DBT, the depth flag marks model-inferred DBT z coordinates, and the underlying radiologist annotations come through multiple clinical annotation workflows.
caveats: The image-metadata table is not one row per region of interest.
Curated ROI coordinates are expected within the attached image bounds; residual out-of-bounds values may be safely clipped.
ROI_SS and ROI_SSC are not the exclusive ROI annotation source; annotation DICOM objects without pixel arrays also supplied coordinates directly.
Stable per-region identity and cross-image correspondence are not represented.
Finding attribution remains conditional on exactly one finding being represented on the same accession side.

coverage.internal-v2.pathology-severity-.subject: aggregation.pathology-severity-to-side
coverage.internal-v2.pathology-severity-.summary: The internal MagView table has no supplied breast-side pathology-severity aggregate column.
caveats: A downstream reduction remains analyst defined and must preserve attribution and null limitations.

coverage.internal-v2.pathology-severity-.subject: aggregation.pathology-severity-to-exam
coverage.internal-v2.pathology-severity-.summary: The internal MagView table has no supplied exam-level pathology-severity aggregate column.
caveats: If an analysis declares an exam grouping, its most-severe reduction uses the minimum represented severity; it is not a supplied feature or default.

coverage.internal-v2.pathology-severity-.subject: aggregation.pathology-severity-to-patient
coverage.internal-v2.pathology-severity-.summary: The internal MagView table has no supplied patient-level pathology-severity result or longitudinal outcome rollup.
caveats: Any patient-level operation must declare grouping, time, multiplicity, and attribution before selecting a minimum severity.

coverage.internal-v2.pathology-code-mean.subject: pathology.diagnosis_code_slot
coverage.internal-v2.pathology-code-mean.summary: Internal MagView represents source-system pathology descriptor codes whose meanings are absent from the comparison dictionaries.
caveats: Preserve unexplained codes without guessing or silently normalizing them.

coverage.internal-v2.outcome-capture.subject: internal-v2.magview-pathology-context
coverage.internal-v2.outcome-capture.summary: The available internal profile evidence does not establish complete outcome capture, outside-system diagnosis capture, or longitudinal follow-up.
caveats: Absence of represented pathology is not proof of disease absence or adequate negative follow-up.

coverage.internal-v2.specimen-staging-bi.subject: internal-v2.magview-pathology-context
coverage.internal-v2.specimen-staging-bi.summary: The inventoried specimen, TNM, stage, concordance, biomarker, margin, and nodal columns are not commonly used and have not been validated as a reliable specimen or staging surface.
caveats: Do not rely on these columns for TNM staging or specimen-level operations without new field-specific validation.
Unknown meanings remain unknown; the profile does not manufacture definitions for infrequently used fields.

coverage.internal-v2.v1c-roi-coordinate-.subject: internal-v2.roi.coordinate_collection
coverage.internal-v2.v1c-roi-coordinate-.summary: Internal V1c ROI rectangles use inclusive [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] coordinates expressed directly in the attached DICOM pixel-array coordinate space without transformation.
caveats: Coordinates are expected to be within the attached image bounds after curation; residual out-of-bounds coordinates may be safely clipped to those valid bounds.

coverage.internal-v2.v1c-image-instance-.subject: image
coverage.internal-v2.v1c-image-instance-.summary: The anon_dicom_path filename without .dcm is the anonymized SOP Instance UID and provides durable image identity within one dataset version, although the UID is not exported as a separate metadata column.
caveats: A missing anon_dicom_path makes the file and exported identity unavailable for that row and likely reflects an anonymization failure.
No identity stability across dataset versions is asserted.

coverage.internal-v2.v1c-image-modality-.subject: internal-v2.v1c-metadata-context
coverage.internal-v2.v1c-image-modality-.summary: Internal V1c covers DICOM objects associated with the complete EMBEDv1 accession set after excluding secondary captures and screen saves, except ROI_SS and ROI_SSC images retained solely for ROI extraction.
caveats: This supported coverage statement is scoped to EMBEDv1, not the later exams and patients represented by internal clinical V2.
ROI_SS and ROI_SSC images are annotation-extraction artifacts and are not intended for other uses.

coverage.internal-v2.v1c-dicom-attribute.subject: internal-v2.v1c-metadata-context
coverage.internal-v2.v1c-dicom-attribute.summary: Inventoried internal V1c columns parsed directly from DICOM retain standard element semantics and received no processing beyond anonymization; many acquisition, dose, detector, collimator, geometry, windowing, icon-image, order-number, and time-of-day attributes remain physically inventoried without dedicated catalogue concepts.
caveats: An unmapped parsed DICOM column is not semantically unknowable: it can be mapped using the standard element meaning when a dedicated catalogue concept is needed.
Pipeline-derived fields require separate evidence, and anonymization of DICOM time-of-day attributes remains unknown.
